IVX HOLDINGS — FINAL END-TO-END COMPLETION BLOCK
FIX THE REAL REMAINING ISSUES, FINISH BUILDS, RUN QA, AND RETURN ONE HONEST PRODUCTION VERDICT

EXECUTE NOW.

DO NOT RETURN ANOTHER LONG STATUS NARRATIVE.
DO NOT REPEAT ALREADY VERIFIED WORK.
DO NOT CALL RUNNING BUILDS “FAILED.”
DO NOT CALL BLOCKED DEVICE FLOWS “VERIFIED.”
DO NOT CREATE A NEW APPLICATION.
DO NOT USE RORK AS A RUNTIME, GIT ROUTER, DEPLOYMENT BROKER, OR PRODUCTION FALLBACK.
DO NOT CLAIM 100% UNTIL EVERY REQUIRED ACCEPTANCE ITEM HAS CURRENT EVIDENCE.

CURRENT KNOWN STATE

VERIFIED:
- GitHub and Render commit parity
- Exposed GitHub token revocation
- No active token in source or current environment
- Hundreds of automated tests passing
- Core chat QA suites passing
- Authentication matrix substantially passing
- Autonomous job engine running
- Production APIs responding
- Rork runtime dependency removed
- Direct owner-controlled GitHub/Render path established

RUNNING:
- Android cloud build
- iOS simulator build
- APK generation from the production commit

REAL REMAINING DEFECTS OR GAPS:
1. Two-hour IVX IA executive report endpoint returns 404
2. Executive report records have no delivered report content
3. Android APK not yet available
4. iOS build not yet complete
5. Real device production flow QA not complete
6. API counts do not reconcile with database-level truth
7. Some autonomous runs fail on transient Postgres timeout
8. Full owner-authenticated end-to-end flow is not yet certified
9. Chat behavior still requires owner physical-device confirmation
10. Final production acceptance report is incomplete

==================================================
GATE 1 — FIX THE TWO-HOUR IVX IA EXECUTIVE REPORT
==================================================

CURRENT DEFECT

The scheduler code exists, but the scheduler status endpoint returns 404 and no executive report instances contain real delivered content.

OBJECTIVE

Create a reliable two-hour executive report pipeline that:

- Runs on the configured schedule
- Reads permanent autonomous run data
- Produces a real executive report
- Stores the report permanently
- Delivers it into IVX Owner AI Chat
- Displays it in the owner dashboard
- Does not duplicate reports
- Survives restart
- Does not mark success when report content is empty

Required architecture:

SCHEDULER
↓
REPORT JOB CREATED
↓
AUTONOMOUS RUN DATA LOADED
↓
REPORT GENERATED
↓
REPORT VALIDATED
↓
REPORT SAVED
↓
IVX OWNER CHAT DELIVERY
↓
OWNER DASHBOARD RECORD
↓
AUDIT LOG

Required endpoints:

- GET scheduler status
- POST manual report trigger
- GET latest report
- GET report history
- GET report by report ID
- GET report job status

Audit and fix:

- Missing or incorrectly mounted route
- Wrong route prefix
- Router registration order
- Wrong HTTP method
- Incorrect authentication middleware
- Wrong production base path
- Scheduler service not registered at boot
- Report job created with zero data
- Empty report accepted as success
- Delivery to the wrong chat table or conversation
- Duplicate schedule instances
- Restart persistence

Required report content:

1. Direct result
2. System health
3. Builds and deployments
4. Autonomous work completed
5. Autonomous failures
6. Investors and buyers discovered
7. Outreach status
8. Registration activity
9. Chat health
10. Security events
11. Performance
12. Owner approvals required
13. Blocked items
14. Next two-hour priorities
15. Exact commit and deployment IDs

Required tests:

[ ] Scheduler endpoint returns 200
[ ] Manual trigger creates one report
[ ] Scheduled trigger creates one report
[ ] Report has non-empty content
[ ] Report data matches permanent run records
[ ] Report saves to database
[ ] Report appears in IVX Owner Chat
[ ] Report appears in dashboard
[ ] Duplicate trigger is deduplicated
[ ] Restart does not lose the report
[ ] Failed report remains visible
[ ] Empty report cannot be marked success

Required final values:

SCHEDULER ENDPOINT: 200
REPORTS WITH CONTENT: greater than 0
DUPLICATE REPORTS: 0
LOST REPORTS: 0
EMPTY SUCCESSFUL REPORTS: 0
DELIVERY TO IVX CHAT: PASS

STOP ONLY WHEN GATE 1 IS VERIFIED.

==================================================
GATE 2 — COMPLETE AND VERIFY ANDROID BUILD
==================================================

Wait for the current Android build.

If it fails:

1. Open the exact build log.
2. Identify the exact failed step.
3. Fix only the root cause.
4. Commit.
5. Trigger a new build.
6. Repeat until FINISHED.

Required:

- Expo config passes
- Prebuild passes
- Gradle passes
- Kotlin passes
- Manifest merge passes
- Bundle passes
- Artifact generated
- Correct package ID
- Correct versionCode
- Correct production API
- No Rork runtime dependency

Return:

ANDROID COMMIT:
ANDROID STATUS:
ANDROID VERSION:
ANDROID VERSION CODE:
ANDROID PACKAGE ID:
APK OR AAB:
ARTIFACT HASH:
BUILD START:
BUILD FINISH:
FAILED STEPS:
WARNINGS:

==================================================

==================================================
GATE 4 — APK DISTRIBUTION
==================================================

After Android build finishes:

1. Publish the APK through the approved owner-controlled path.
2. Provide a direct owner-accessible artifact.
3. Show build ID, version, commit, and hash.
4. Do not publish an old APK as the current build.
5. Confirm the artifact matches the GitHub commit.

Required:

==================================================
GATE 5 — FIX TRANSIENT POSTGRES AUTONOMOUS FAILURES
==================================================

CURRENT ISSUE

Some autonomous runs fail because of transient Postgres statement timeouts.

Required remediation:

- Identify the exact slow queries
- Capture query plans
- Add or verify indexes
- Bound query result sizes
- Add cursor pagination
- Replace unbounded scans
- Set appropriate per-query timeout
- Implement retry only for transient failures
- Use exponential backoff with jitter
- Prevent duplicate mutation during retry
- Log trace ID and query category
- Do not classify timeout as business failure when retry succeeds

Required tests:

- Normal query
- Slow query
- Timeout
- Retry
- Retry success
- Retry exhausted
- Duplicate prevention
- Worker restart during retry
- Database reconnect

Required:

FAILED RUNS FROM TRANSIENT TIMEOUT AFTER RETRY: 0
DUPLICATE MUTATIONS: 0
LOST RUNS: 0
UNBOUNDED QUERIES: 0

==================================================

==================================================

- SEC discovery records are not active CRM investors unless classified correctly
- Every dashboard total must open the supporting records
